title: Sensations have intrinsic properties, but no particular quale is essential to a mental state

statements.text: The functionalist need not deny that sensations have intrinsic properties, the qualia discriminated in introspection, or that these are how sensations are told apart. What functionalism denies is that any particular quale is essential to the identity of a type of mental state. Intrinsic properties as such are no problem for a functionalist theory.
